before.title: Database recovery lab
before.content:
Objective
Recover our shared notebook after accidental data loss.

Method
Save notes in Folio, create a backup, change the records, then restore the selected snapshot.

Expected result
The original titles, content, IDs and timestamps return exactly.

before.title: Presentation checklist
before.content:
Before the demo
Open Folio and save the lab observations.
Create a verified PostgreSQL backup in MinIO.

During the demo
Edit one note and delete another.
Remove only the isolated database volume.
Restore the selected backup and compare every field.

changed.title: Changed after backup
changed.content:
This content was saved after the selected backup.
It must be replaced by the original lab observations when that snapshot is restored.

changed.title: Post-backup note
changed.content: Created after the recovery point. This note must disappear when the earlier snapshot is restored.
